output:
{
  "world_id": "wld_abyssal_shares",
  "title": "Abyssal Shares",
  "logline": "As a sentient leviathan links Mariana Six's workers through shared memories, three rival department heads and a maintenance worker must decide whether to protect the animal, harvest it, or risk opening the Pressure Gate to evacuate the colony.",
  "theme": "Care without consent can become another form of control.",
  "acts": [
    {
      "id": "act_setup",
      "title": "Evacuation Lockout",
      "purpose": "setup",
      "scenes": [
        {
          "id": "scn_gate_confrontation",
          "title": "Three Claims at the Gate",
          "summary": "At the sealed Pressure Gate, Tamsin explains that conflicting contamination reports prompted the lockout. Ilya demands access to the Brood Vault, while Marek argues that delay threatens the Enzyme Works and its workers.",
          "location_id": "loc_pressure_gate",
          "character_ids": ["chr_tamsin_reed", "chr_ilya_voss", "chr_marek_sato"],
          "goal": "Determine who can authorize the next step in the emergency.",
          "conflict": "Contract authority is divided, and each chief's plan threatens another department's essential system.",
          "outcome": "No one yields control; the chiefs agree to inspect the evidence before committing to a course of action."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_shared_alarm",
          "title": "An Alarm Remembered",
          "summary": "In Mantle Habitat, workers finish one another's sentences and react together to an alarm. Nia tells Tamsin the Shared Current can coordinate quickly, but its members do not necessarily agree.",
          "location_id": "loc_mantle_habitat",
          "character_ids": ["chr_nia_okafor", "chr_tamsin_reed"],
          "goal": "Establish whether the linked workers can help assess an evacuation.",
          "conflict": "Tamsin wants reliable safety information, while Nia distrusts another decision made without workers' consent.",
          "outcome": "Tamsin agrees to hear from the workers directly, but Nia withholds the existence of the hidden logs."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_pattern_reading",
          "title": "A Pattern, Not a Reflex",
          "summary": "Ilya studies the Brood Vault's feeding lights and recognizes a pattern consistent with the memory fragments reported by workers. The leviathan responds to changes around its enclosure, but its intentions remain uncertain.",
          "location_id": "loc_brood_vault",
          "character_ids": ["chr_ilya_voss", "chr_leviathan"],
          "goal": "Determine whether the leviathan's behavior supports an intact-capture plan.",
          "conflict": "Ilya's behavioral reading suggests communication, but her possessive instinct still treats custody as protection.",
          "outcome": "Ilya concludes that a lethal harvest would destroy a possible communicator and decides to seek intact containment."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "act_rising",
      "title": "Evidence and Exposure",
      "purpose": "rising_action",
      "scenes": [
        {
          "id": "scn_production_pause",
          "title": "The Batch That Cannot Pass",
          "summary": "At the Enzyme Works, Marek finds that the production disruption has left no basis for certifying a new batch. The required tissue trace and independent custody signatures are unavailable.",
          "location_id": "loc_enzymeworks",
          "character_ids": ["chr_marek_sato"],
          "goal": "Keep the processing line from failing without passing off an unverified harvest as commercial stock.",
          "conflict": "Production pressure clashes with the sample-chain rules Marek is responsible for enforcing.",
          "outcome": "Marek halts processing rather than certify unsupported material, costing the colony output and intensifying pressure to act."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_baffle_copy",
          "title": "The Copy in the Baffles",
          "summary": "Nia leads Ilya through service access to the Silt Archive and reveals the duplicate breeding logs hidden in obsolete acoustic baffles. The copy may clarify the breeding history, but its provenance could implicate the contractors.",
          "location_id": "loc_silt_archive",
          "character_ids": ["chr_nia_okafor", "chr_ilya_voss"],
          "goal": "Bring the hidden logs into the decision without handing them to one corporation.",
          "conflict": "Ilya wants evidence to support custody; Nia fears that disclosure will turn the copy into exclusive corporate property.",
          "outcome": "Nia lets Ilya inspect the copy but insists it be shared with the workers and all three chiefs."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_report_disclosed",
          "title": "The Anomaly Report",
          "summary": "The Shared Current makes workers' recollections of Ilya's concealed anomaly report impossible for her to dismiss. Ilya admits she filed the first pattern as a husbandry issue and shares what she observed.",
          "location_id": "loc_silt_archive",
          "character_ids": ["chr_ilya_voss", "chr_nia_okafor"],
          "goal": "Compare Ilya's observations with the hidden breeding records.",
          "conflict": "Ilya fears losing control of the animal and the program she helped protect; Nia needs disclosure before workers can weigh the risk.",
          "outcome": "Ilya acknowledges the concealment, and the group treats the logs as evidence of uncertainty rather than proof of a single cause."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_gate_risk_review",
          "title": "The Cost of Opening",
          "summary": "At the Pressure Gate, Tamsin assesses the manual controls and the floodable service chamber. Nia describes the workers' shared perceptions, while stressing that no collective response proves unanimous consent.",
          "location_id": "loc_pressure_gate",
          "character_ids": ["chr_tamsin_reed", "chr_nia_okafor"],
          "goal": "Judge whether opening the gate could support an evacuation without exposing workers to an unacceptable hazard.",
          "conflict": "The gate is the routine evacuation route, but opening it could also admit a recovery team or worsen the danger.",
          "outcome": "Tamsin refuses to decide alone and asks Nia to help bring the workers' differing views into the discussion."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_harvest_dispute",
          "title": "No Safe Shortcut",
          "summary": "Marek joins Ilya at the Enzyme Works and argues that a controlled harvest could preserve production. Ilya challenges the plan with the disclosed pattern and records; Marek admits the sample chain cannot validate an improvised harvest.",
          "location_id": "loc_enzymeworks",
          "character_ids": ["chr_marek_sato", "chr_ilya_voss"],
          "goal": "Choose whether to prepare the leviathan for capture or harvest.",
          "conflict": "Marek's production-first instinct conflicts with Ilya's evidence of possible communication, and neither has authority over the other's system.",
          "outcome": "Marek agrees not to initiate a harvest without traceable samples and signatures, leaving the gate decision as the immediate crisis."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "act_climax",
      "title": "One Gate, Two Outcomes",
      "purpose": "climax",
      "scenes": [
        {
          "id": "scn_workers_weigh_risk",
          "title": "A Shared but Divided Answer",
          "summary": "In Mantle Habitat, Nia relays the evidence and asks the linked workers to consider the gate's risks individually. Their shared perceptions speed the exchange, but different recollections and fears prevent a single unanimous answer.",
          "location_id": "loc_mantle_habitat",
          "character_ids": ["chr_nia_okafor", "chr_tamsin_reed", "chr_ilya_voss", "chr_marek_sato"],
          "goal": "Give workers a meaningful role in deciding whether evacuation is worth the gate risk.",
          "conflict": "The chiefs want a clear authorization, but the Shared Current cannot be treated as one consenting voice.",
          "outcome": "The workers' discussion supports a staged evacuation with disclosed risks, while some remain unwilling to approach the gate."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_gate_decision",
          "title": "Open for Evacuation",
          "summary": "At the Pressure Gate, Tamsin shares the manual-control risks and opens the gate for a staged evacuation. Ilya refuses to use the opening to claim the leviathan, and Marek keeps the processing line halted rather than make an unverified harvest.",
          "location_id": "loc_pressure_gate",
          "character_ids": ["chr_tamsin_reed", "chr_nia_okafor", "chr_ilya_voss", "chr_marek_sato"],
          "goal": "Carry out the workers' evacuation choice without turning the gate into a route for corporate capture or an undocumented harvest.",
          "conflict": "Opening the only routine exit is costly and uncertain; the chiefs must resist using the emergency to impose their competing agendas.",
          "outcome": "The gate is opened for evacuation, the brood remains unharvested, and the chiefs accept that the colony's assets will not be secured before people are moved."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_brood_response",
          "title": "A Response Without Ownership",
          "summary": "At the Brood Vault, Ilya observes another feeding-light pattern while workers begin the evacuation. She does not claim to know what the leviathan intends and does not attempt to capture it as the price of preserving it.",
          "location_id": "loc_brood_vault",
          "character_ids": ["chr_ilya_voss", "chr_leviathan"],
          "goal": "Keep the evacuation from becoming an extraction operation and observe the leviathan without controlling it.",
          "conflict": "Ilya's old instinct equates custody with care, while the creature's communication remains entangled with signals that expose workers.",
          "outcome": "Ilya leaves the animal alive and contained by the station's existing enclosure, accepting that its choices cannot be hers to make."
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "act_resolution",
      "title": "After the Lockout",
      "purpose": "resolution",
      "scenes": [
        {
          "id": "scn_shared_records",
          "title": "Evidence Held in Common",
          "summary": "In the Silt Archive, Nia presents the breeding-log copy and Ilya's disclosed report to the workers and chiefs together. Marek confirms the records cannot validate a commercial batch, and no contractor receives exclusive possession.",
          "location_id": "loc_silt_archive",
          "character_ids": ["chr_nia_okafor", "chr_ilya_voss", "chr_marek_sato", "chr_tamsin_reed"],
          "goal": "Preserve the evidence and prevent any one contractor from using it to settle ownership claims.",
          "conflict": "Each corporation has an incentive to control the records, while the workers need access to information that affects their safety.",
          "outcome": "The copy and report remain shared evidence; the disputed cause of the sentience and ownership of the leviathan remain unresolved."
        },
        {
          "id": "scn_departure_terms",
          "title": "A Colony Left Unsettled",
          "summary": "At the Pressure Gate, Tamsin continues the staged evacuation with the workers' participation. Marek accepts the loss of immediate output, and Ilya leaves the leviathan behind rather than claim it as Pelagic property.",
          "location_id": "loc_pressure_gate",
          "character_ids": ["chr_tamsin_reed", "chr_marek_sato", "chr_ilya_voss", "chr_nia_okafor"],
          "goal": "Continue moving workers to safety while preserving their ability to choose whether to leave.",
          "conflict": "Evacuation costs the contractors control and production, and the sentient animal remains in a dangerous, contested colony.",
          "outcome": "The workers are no longer treated as a production resource or a unanimous mind; Mariana Six remains behind with the leviathan alive and no agreed owner."
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
